This set of armor has three pieces which are crafted and upgraded at the Black forge. Flametal armor can currently only be upgraded to quality level 3.

full_text:
Flametal Armor

Introduction. Flametal Armor is an Ashlands-tier armor. This set is the tier above Carapace Armor and Eitr-weave Set and currently has the highest armor value in the game. Equal level sets include Embla Set and Ask Set.

Armor pieces. This set of armor has three pieces which are crafted and upgraded at the Black forge. Flametal armor can currently only be upgraded to quality level 3.
Flametal armor's heat resistance reduces the damage done by Lava and extends the time without taking damage in Boiling water. It does not affect fire damage or damage from burning.

Notes. • At its lowest level, Flametal Armor has the same armor value as Carapace Armor at max level. However, while fully upgraded Carapace Armor has higher durability, Flametal Armor may still be preferable due to its heat resistance buff.
